name: pull-requests
title: Pull requests
summary: Every fix or feature ends as a proven, reviewed draft pull request, and ship words take it to merged.
day: You ask for a fix, and later find a draft pull request with its tests, its proof, and a review from a second model.
cost: It needs GitHub, and setup signs you in. Each pull request spends extra usage on reviews. Expect at least one round, often two, and short final reads.
risk: Ship words merge without asking again. Say them only for work you would merge yourself.

workflows.name: Draft PR flow
workflows.sentence: Every fix or feature ends as a proven, reviewed draft pull request that you mark ready yourself.

workflows.name: PR care
workflows.sentence: When you ask, an agent watches a pull request, fixes CI, and answers review comments, and it can refresh a stale one.

workflows.name: Ship words
workflows.sentence: Say "full send" or "stamp it", and the agent takes a pull request to merged and rolled out.
workflows.risk: The agent merges without asking again once you say the words.

workflows.name: PR owners
workflows.sentence: A thread that still owns an open pull request cannot settle or archive itself until it hands the pull request over, and a box with such a thread is not released.
